references.context: The top lane group supplies the first completion for each numbered set.
references.label: Numbered top lanes
references.description: Plunge lanes across the top of the playfield. Lanes 2 and 3 award both numbers in three-ball play and score separately in five-ball play.

references.context: The green 2 and green 3 stand-up targets share credit in three-ball play and score separately in five-ball play.
references.label: Green 2 and 3 targets
references.description: Green stand-up targets that share credit in three-ball play and score separately in five-ball play.

references.context: The right-side lane can substitute for the yellow 2 stand-up target.
references.label: Yellow 2 side lane
references.description: Lane on the right side that supplies the yellow completion for number 2.

references.context: The lower-right #3 target supplies yellow 3 and can be backhanded.
references.label: Yellow 3 target
references.description: Low stand-up target on the right side of the playfield.

references.context: The upper disk rollover can substitute for the green 4 target.
references.label: Green 4 disk rollover
references.description: Round rollover above the upper target and bumper area.

references.context: The #4 lane can feed the #2 rollover for a second numbered collect.
references.label: Number 4 lane
references.description: Upper numbered lane that can continue into the number 2 rollover.

references.context: The #2 rollover sits below the #4 lane and can score after that feed.
references.label: Number 2 rollover
references.description: Rollover below the number 4 lane on the right side.

references.context: The left saucer always awards 5,000 before kicking the ball back into play.
references.label: 5,000 saucer
references.description: Kickout hole on the left side with a fixed 5,000-point award.
